prompts.lower: Return only ONE wide horizontal isolated photographic vegetable grouping with real transparency. Re-photograph the arrangement in this reference in its existing pose with fresh naturalistic detail. Match its big shapes, camera angle, asymmetry, size relationships and where objects conceal portions of their neighbours. Pull back just enough to complete the outlines in a small transparent margin. No lettering, props, board or opaque background. Realistic soft daylight from upper left. Retain natural shadows BETWEEN touching objects. No blanket texture, exaggerated blemishes, droplets, stylised shine or decorative speckling. This is primarily a POSE and ANATOMY task. Study the left half of the supplied photograph: the bunch tips diagonally towards bottom right, the shoulders overlap at unequal heights. Match the actual four different carrot shapes in this image. Front-left carrot is a SHORT thick, blunt, roughly cylindrical little stump with fine whiskers underneath. Immediately behind and above it a medium straight pointed carrot; behind that a much fatter angular irregular carrot rests ON the others, stepping down in girth roughly two thirds along with one fine root at its end; partly concealed farthest back one smaller slender carrot. Shoulders lean into one another, irregular waistlines, no evenly pitched curves. Unequal lengths, one elbow under a burly shoulder, irregular one-sided growth, restrained knuckles and faint pale stretch lines. The fibres, twists and snapped leaf stalks follow gravity. Moist dark earth confined to a few joins, fresh and edible. Carrot foliage splays over the top-left; purple-veined kale leaves lie rumpled to the right; follow the broad flatter, glaucous leaves and spacing of the reference. Make the carrots substantial with real weight against the board; simply omit the board itself for compositing.
